Description: AnoX Channel3 catalog and fresh product details with scoped credentials, expiring caches, atomic upstream budgets and alarms.

Channel3SecretArn.Description: Existing Channel3 secret ARN; only the deployed Lambda resolves its value.

ExistingHttpApiId.Description: Existing HTTP API. Adds only the dedicated Channel3 detail route; existing routes remain owned by their stacks.

BudgetMonth.Description: Explicit UTC allocation month YYYY-MM; empty or elapsed month disables upstream calls. Renew only after provider usage and other consumers are reconciled.

FreeSearchMonthlyCredits.Description: Verified remaining monthly free search credits allocated to this service, not the provider account balance. Default zero.

PaidUsageEnabled.Description: Explicit opt-in for separately approved paid search credits; does not allocate credits by itself.

PaidSearchMonthlyCredits.Description: Explicit paid search credit allocation for BudgetMonth, requires PaidUsageEnabled=true. Zero by default; no automatic renewal.

SearchDailyLimit.Description: Search request attempts per UTC day within the approved monthly allocation. Zero disables new upstream searches, not cached pages.

DetailMonthlyLimit.Description: Explicit product-detail request allocation for BudgetMonth; product retrieval currently has zero listed credit cost, but consumes account request quota.

DetailDailyLimit.Description: Product-detail attempts per UTC day within the monthly request allocation. Zero disables new detail requests.

TotalDailyLimit.Description: Shared daily request cap across both classes; not the provider free monthly allowance or a paid spending allocation.

UpstreamPerSecondLimit.Description: Shared fixed-window request cap per second across search and detail.

ExistingAlarmTopicArn.Description: Optional existing standard SNS topic authorized to receive CloudWatch alarms. Empty creates visible alarms without notifications.

Properties.AlarmDescription: Search HTTP attempts reach the configured daily cap. This credit-bearing endpoint count does not distinguish invoiced/free credits and is not billing reconciliation.
Product-detail attempts reach the configured request quota. Product retrieval is zero-credit in current public documentation, not the paid lookup endpoint.
The distributed monthly, daily or shared upstream allocation denied a request.
Channel3 catalog or detail retrieval is failing.
The budget counter could not be reserved; upstream calls fail closed.

CacheTableName.Description: Expiring Channel3 cache table; independent from CJ products.

FunctionArn.Description: IAM-only fresh detail invocation target for the separate commerce runtime.
